name: platformio-mcp
description: PIO Agent builds, flashes, tests, and monitors PlatformIO firmware safely from Codex using PlatformIO MCP.

interface.longDescription: PIO Agent connects Codex to local PlatformIO projects and devices. Inspect boards, build firmware, request approval for flashing, monitor serial output, run hardware tests, and view project activity in the PIO Agent panel. Node.js and PlatformIO Core must be installed locally; physical actions require attached hardware and policy approval.
defaultPrompt: Inspect and validate this PlatformIO project.
Build, flash with approval, and verify the device output.
Open the PIO Agent dashboard and monitor this device.
